<div class="card-body">
'''Infantry Mine''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Automated Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">対人地雷</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の地雷敷設ドロイドの1体と同じ屋外の位置に配備する。キャラクターがその位置に配備されるか移動してきたなら“爆発”する。ただし、ビークルや宇宙戦闘機を使用して移動してきた場合には爆発しない。運命数を引く。運命数＋2＞能力値なら、キャラクターはロストする。対人地雷もロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Infantry-Mine-PSA-96471724.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">その多くは反乱軍のスパイや工作員が、厳重に警備された帝国軍施設の防衛線から盗み出してきたものである。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Infantry Mine.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy at the same exterior location as one of your mining droids. It explodes if a character deploys or moves to that location. It does not explode if that move used a vehicle or starfighter. Draw destiny. If destiny +2 exceeds ability, the character is lost. The infantry mine is also lost.

'''Lore:'''
Most of them were stolen by Rebel spies and saboteurs from the defensive line of heavily guarded Imperial facilities.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title 対人地雷 is shared with the Dark card.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Infantry Mine]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
